forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8780'
+title: 'Confirm: an inner tools.* terminal event can take the place of the outer runCode terminal'
+---
+## What
+The timer audit found a possible defect in the engine of FoundationModelsExtras. It is not confirmed.
+
+Path:
+1. An inner `tools.*` call is mounted through `ToolContext.mount(_:op:as:)`. Its sink is `MountedRunUpstreamSink` (`.build/checkouts/FoundationModelsExtras/Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/Hosting/ToolContext.swift:331`). `post(event:)` sends each event of the inner run to the outer context with `context.post(event)`.
+2. When the inner run fails or times out, `RunEventFunnel.settleRun(with:)` (`.build/checkouts/FoundationModelsExtras/Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/Hosting/ToolRun.swift` near line 317) posts the inner terminal event (`.completed`) upstream.
+3. The outer funnel's `post` sets its own `hasDeliveredTerminal = true` for a `.completed` event (`ToolRun.swift` near lines 295-297). Then the outer `settleRun` returns early, and the outer `runCode` terminal event is never sent.
+
+If this is correct, the session sink gets the terminal outcome of the inner call (for example `.timedOut` or `.failed` of `tools.x`) in place of the outcome of the `runCode` call. The snippet can catch the inner error and succeed.
+
+Subtasks:
+- [ ] Write a test in this package that mounts `runCode` (pattern of `InlineSettleGraceTests.mounted(_:on:)`) with a snippet that calls an inner tool that throws, catches the error, and returns a value. Record the events of the session sink.
+- [ ] If the outer terminal event is missing or has the inner outcome, the defect is confirmed. Then write the same failing test in FoundationModelsExtras and fix `MountedRunUpstreamSink` there: do not send a `.completed` event of a mounted run up as a terminal event of the mounting run (for example, convert it to a non-terminal event, or send no terminal event).
+- [ ] If the outer terminal event is correct, record the evidence on this card and close it.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A mounted `runCode` whose snippet catches an inner failure and returns a value gives exactly one terminal event with outcome `.succeeded` for the `runCode` completion token.
+- [ ] A mounted `runCode` whose snippet does not catch an inner failure gives exactly one terminal event for the `runCode` completion token.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New test file `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/InnerTerminalEventTests.swift` with the two cases above.
+- [ ] If a fix in FoundationModelsExtras is necessary: a regression test in that package, and `swift package update` here before the run.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter InnerTerminalEventTests` passes. `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #timeouts #defect #extras
\ No newline at end of file
